title: Days since last completed order, per customer
prompt: As of 2025-08-31, for each customer with at least one completed order, how many days has it been since their most recent completed order? This feeds a win-back campaign list.
population: Completed orders, restricted to each customer's single most recent one.
metricDefinition: days since most recent completed order, per customer, as of 2025-08-31.
referenceSql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, order_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date DESC) AS rn FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed') SELECT customer_id, order_date AS most_recent_order_date, DATE '2025-08-31' - order_date AS days_since_order FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY days_since_order DESC

commonWrongAnswers.sql: SELECT customer_id, max(order_date) AS most_recent_order_date FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id
commonWrongAnswers.whyWrong: Gets the right date but not the days-since figure, and can't safely pull other columns from that specific order (like order_id) without a window function or self-join.
